# Hobart Cleaning Services

> Flat-rate house cleaning in Hobart, priced by the size of the home. Instant online price estimate and online booking.

## Services
- Premium house clean: one time, weekly (10% off), every 2 weeks (5% off) or every 4 weeks
- Spring / deep clean: priced by number of bedrooms
- End of lease clean: backed by a Bond Back Guarantee

## Contact
- Phone: 0458 283 459
- Service area: we travel to customers in Hobart
- Hours: 7 days a week, 8am to 8pm
- Website: https://hobartcleaningservices.vercel.app/

## Prices (flat rate by home size, estimates for a property in good condition)
- Once-off house clean: studio and 1 bedroom $132, 2 bedrooms $165, 3 bedrooms $198, 4 bedrooms $264
- Spring / deep clean from: studio and 1 bedroom $231, 2 bedrooms $297, 3 bedrooms $363, 4 bedrooms $462
- End of lease from: 1 bedroom $440, 2 bedrooms $550, 3 bedrooms $660, 4 bedrooms $990
- Weekly cleans 10% off, fortnightly 5% off
